Definition: A control for choosing a number by moving a thumb along a track.
The small circle a person drags along a slider's track. Its place on the track shows the number.
The smallest number a slider can choose. The left end of the track.
The largest number a slider can choose. The right end of the track.
How much one press of an arrow key changes a slider's number. Dragging the thumb also moves in steps.
How much one press of Page Up or Page Down changes a slider's number.
A slider with a small number box beside it. The box shows the number, and a person can type an exact number in it.
How finely something can be measured or chosen. A slider with a step of 0.1 has finer granularity than one with a step of 1.
